_README: Machine-readable token-supply inventory for the V5 mixture plan.
All token counts are in BILLIONS of tokens, measured with a ~100k BPE vocabulary.
published - the number appears in the dataset card or the paper that released it.
estimate  - we derived it (rows * mean-tokens-per-row, or subset fraction). Error bars in `confidence`.
derived   - NOT new unique tokens. A re-packing / re-formatting of tokens already counted
in another row. Contributes 0 to unique supply. Used for the long-context lane.
overlap_discount: fraction of this dataset's tokens that we assume are already counted in
another row of this inventory (near-duplicate across corpora). Effective unique supply is
unique_tokens_b * (1 - overlap_discount). Sourced from published dedup rates where available,
otherwise a deliberately conservative (high) guess so we under-claim supply rather than over-claim.

datasets.notes: DCLM-Baseline. Model-filtered CommonCrawl. Our MMLU/GPQA workhorse.
Heavy overlap with DCLM (same CC substrate, different classifier). High discount is deliberate.
High-quality subset of Nemotron-CC (6.3T total). Includes synthetic rephrasings of CC.
Small but disproportionately useful for MMLU-style factual recall.
The Stack v2, permissive-licence subset, near-dedup applied. THE binding constraint on the code lane.
Educational-quality filter OVER Stack v2. 100% discount: it is a subset, not new supply. Listed because it defines WHICH Stack v2 tokens we repeat.
StarCoder2-style extras: GitHub issues, PR threads, Jupyter notebooks, library documentation.
Filtered commit-diff pairs. Directly shaped like the SWE-bench edit task.
Largest open math pretraining corpus. Overlaps OpenWebMath and CC math.
FineMath 3+. The 4+ subset (9.6B) is our Tier A anneal math.
Subsumed in large part by MegaMath.
AlgebraicStack + arXiv math + OpenWebMath. Formal-ish proofs, Lean/Isabelle.
Overlaps Proof-Pile-2's arXiv slice.
S2ORC-derived scientific papers. Primary GPQA-Diamond feedstock.

Open long-chain-of-thought traces: OpenThoughts-3 (~5B), Nemotron post-training reasoning (~25B), OpenR1-Math-220k (~1.2B), AM-DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.4M (~6B). Heavy cross-distillation overlap; 30% discount is optimistic and flagged as such.
AI4Bharat Sangraha, human/heuristic-verified native tier. 22 languages. The single most valuable Indic asset that exists.
Sangraha unverified native tier: perplexity/LID-filtered web crawl, not human-audited.
Romanised/transliterated tier. Matters because a large share of real Indian user input is Romanised.
24 languages. Substantially re-crawled into Sangraha, hence the large discount.
14 Indic languages + English, DailyHunt news. Editorially clean = verified tier.
Indic Wikipedias, public-domain books, government gazettes/parliamentary records.
Indic slice of MADLAD-400. Known LID noise; large overlap with Sangraha unverified.
Human/mined parallel corpora. NOT bulk translation supply - it is the SEED and QUALITY ANCHOR that lets us trust machine-translated tokens.
~126k multi-step API dialogues. The largest single natural agentic corpus we could find.
Verified function-calling data. BFCL-shaped.
Single-turn heavy. Teaches schema adherence, not long-horizon planning.
Complex/nested tool schemas.
AgentInstruct-style 1M-instruction pools. Mostly single-tool; weak long-horizon signal.
SWE-Gym / SWE-smith / R2E-Gym rollouts. Execution-verified, highest value per token in the lane.
Genuinely public shell-session transcripts (asciinema, tutorials). Effectively nil.
Natively long documents. One of the few true long-context token sources.
Whole-repository packing (dependency-ordered file concatenation) of Stack v2. ZERO new unique tokens - it is a packing STRATEGY over code-lane tokens. Counted in the code lane's supply, not here.
Full-paper (not chunked) arXiv/peS2o. Re-packing of STEM-lane tokens.
Long agentic rollouts packed to 32-128k. Generated by the agentic synthesis pipeline; budgeted in the agentic lane.
